race.comment: SUMMER FORCE (8) warmed up strongly on debut with a respectable second over 1100m at this track. Finds a fairly average race today and has the ability to overcome the sticky gate. Sure to go close. MAY THE FORCE (10) improving filly who resumed for her second campaign with a tenacious on-speed third over 1300m at this track. Will tighten up after that outing and shapes as the main danger. THIRTY DEGREES (7) comes here deep into the prep and is building towards his Maiden win at start twelve. Held a forward position again with a fighting second over 1280m at Muswellbrook. Well drawn and gets every chance. MORPETH (11) struggled to run the 1400m out from the awkward draw when eleventh over 1400m at Gunnedah. Lone placing came on a heavy surface and goes into the exotics.
